name: sim_gtower_g2_exceptional_geometry
scope_note: G2 is a lateral/pendant node in the G-tower hypergraph. dim(G2)=14 > dim(SU3)=8; G2 contains SU3, not the reverse. Cartan matrix non-symmetric -> non-simply-laced exceptional group.
language: G2-admissible = G2 is exceptional, rank 2, dim 14, contains SU3 as subgroup; excluded from being a step in GL3->Sp6 chain.

pyg.reason: no graph learning required; probe operates on density matrices not graph structures

z3.reason: UNSAT proofs for N1 (G2 cannot be subgroup of SU3) and N2 (Cartan matrix cannot be symmetric); structural impossibility proofs

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: Cartan matrix construction, determinant, root dimension formula; P1/P3 results materially depend on symbolic matrix operations

clifford.reason: no Clifford rotor or geometric algebra computation required in this probe

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: no graph traversal or path computation required in this probe

xgi.reason: no hypergraph structure required; probe uses standard matrix operations

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe
